systems.country_label: Unique Number ID (unified digital ID for those under 18)
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs / National Identification Authority (NIDA)
systems.tiers: Pilot planned for 235,826 minors in Zanzibar and the Iringa and Mbeya regions, budgeted TZS 11.34 billion for 2025/26, ahead of a nationwide rollout envisaged for 2026/27

Connects the immigration department, the Zanzibar civil status registration agency and the Registration Insolvency and Trusteeship Agency for data exchange and ID issuance at airports, hospitals and border posts

note: An identity pilot for minors and a data-exchange portal; the minister's plan to integrate birth registration with the national ID so newborns are registered before leaving hospital is stated as a plan, with no civil registration system described.
